# AI Feature Review

## Inputs
- Feature scope and user value
- Deterministic fallback definition
- Data exposure boundaries

## Procedure
1. Validate AI necessity and fallback behavior.
2. Define required/prohibited context payloads.
3. Define schema, provenance, and uncertainty handling.
4. Define timeout/cancel/refusal behavior.
5. Define adversarial and hallucination test plan.

## Output Contract
- AI contract checklist
- Safety and privacy assessment
- Test cases for failure and misuse
